title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 1, Fugue 16 in G minor

character.text: Verset fugue with a subject designed for stretto

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject and a figure from countersubject 1. Tenor: a figure from the subject (3 times) and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence rising by a third every half bar. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted and a figure from the subject and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted. Returns in Link (bar 16).
sections.leads: From D minor to B♭ major; perfect cadence in G minor at bar 10; perfect cadence in B♭ major at bar 12

sections.label: Answer in F major (Bass); Subject in F major (Soprano)
Link
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 8–11) in part, with the soprano's line in the alto, the tenor's line in the soprano, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Soprano: a figure from the subject. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted. Returns in Episode 4 (bars 30–31).
sections.leads: From F major to B♭ major

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in B♭ major (Bass); Subject in E♭ major (Alto)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 4) in part, with the soprano's line in the bass, the alto's line in the soprano, the lines moved by different intervals. Soprano: a figure from the subject and a figure from the subject, inverted. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted. Bass: a figure from the subject. Returns in Episode 3 (bars 24–27).
sections.leads: From E♭ major to C minor

sections.label: Subject in G minor, rhythm varied (Alto)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 2 (bar 19) in part, with soprano and alto exchanged, a sixth higher. Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1 (4 times) and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted (4 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (3 times), in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (6 times), in a sequence falling by a third every bar.
sections.leads: Between two statements in G minor

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in G minor (Soprano); Subject in G minor (Tenor)
Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks Link (bar 16) in part, in the same voices, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Soprano: a figure from the subject and the opening of countersubject 1. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted.
sections.leads: Between two statements in G minor

sections.label: Subject in G minor (Alto); Subject in G minor (Tenor)

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence rising by a third every half bar. Alto: a figure from the subject. Returns in Episode 2 (bar 19).
